title: Temperature Doesn't Fix It: Replicating Persistent Collapse Across Sampling Settings

original_idea.body: Replicating persistence-of-collapse across sampling settings and contrasting interventions (arXiv:2505.18949, arXiv:2510.01171).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (which interventions reduce homogeneity) but mitigation-to-catastrophe link skips steps.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Sampling sweep + standard diversity metrics; clear methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (intervention-vs-homogeneity chart), multi-knob adds breadth.

novelty.reasoning: Persistence-of-collapse claims are established; largely confirmation.
